args.body: Use the queued pilot evidence readback to resolve the existing item 4 send-or-decline handoff. First reuse a committed operator decision if one exists. Otherwise identify and read the exact draft cited by the handoff. Check its offer claims, link and pre-send conditions against the direct catalogue readback. If the live release supports the draft, use the existing operator handoff once for the authorized send-or-decline decision. If the draft relies on the unpublished candidate, record the exact claim and reconsider when the approved revision is verified live. Agents do not send externally. Preserve separate evidence for any send, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement.

description: Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback feed is available, but it shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The catalogue dry run confirmed the candidate digest. Publication depends on host-confirmed independent approval for that exact digest. The existing catalogue pilot can proceed independently if its exact draft is supported by the verified live offer and the authorized operator elects to send it. This turn prioritizes resolving that decision over another broad search.
